description: High-resolution Office Building Electricity Consumption Dataset, published by Petrík, Filip; Höger, Marek; Bracinik, Peter, records electricity consumption in an office building near Žilina. Coverage: One office building near Žilina, 16 February 2025 through 15 February 2026. The repository supplies a public deposit and file listing. Only metadata was read; the files, schemas and calculations were not executed or checked. The deposit is marked cc-by-4.0. Its public landing page and listed open files are available without a login; upstream source conditions may also apply. Limitations: Missing electricity values were imputed. One office building does not establish transferability to the national building stock. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
